description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for task-related database operations using Room persistence library in an Android app. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting TaskEntity objects.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for tasks, annotated as a Room DAO.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the list of all tasks, ordered by completion status and last update time.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve a task by its ID.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Suspended function to get the total number of tasks.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Suspended function to insert a task, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Suspended function to insert multiple tasks, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Suspended function to update a task.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Suspended function to delete a specific task.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Suspended function to delete a task by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCompleted
methods.description: Suspended function to delete all completed tasks.
